# Price and Trade Reference Files

This folder stores public trade, price, EITI, company report, and policy source files used to support price-gap and value-chain analysis.

Keep source files in their downloaded form where possible. Add a note to `docs/materials_index.md` when a new source is added.

Current contents include WITS cobalt exports, EITI indicator values for DRC, Benchmark lithium methodology, DRC/Guinea price and trade policy PDFs, and Ivanhoe public reporting.
